'''''Fate of the Jedi: Abyss''''' is the third novel in the nine-book [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series set two years after ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' by [[Troy Denning]] and was released on [[August 18]], [[2009]]. At the end of the book, it has an introduction to [[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash|''Backlash'']].<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=9135|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|nobackup=1}}</ref> The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[June 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="Sue">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=270737&start=645|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs 3.0|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|check=1}}</ref>
